WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, cu.cust_city AS city, t.calendar_quarter_id AS q, s.amount_sold AS amt
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_iso_code = 'US' AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),
city_q AS (
  SELECT city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1772 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS s19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1776 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS s20
  FROM base GROUP BY city
),
good AS (SELECT city FROM city_q WHERE s19 > 0 AND s20 >= 1.2 * s19),
b AS (SELECT * FROM base WHERE city IN (SELECT city FROM good)),
qt AS (SELECT q, SUM(amt) AS tot FROM b GROUP BY q),
pq AS (SELECT prod_id, q, SUM(amt) AS psales FROM b GROUP BY prod_id, q),
ps AS (SELECT pq.prod_id, pq.q, pq.psales * 1.0 / qt.tot AS share FROM pq JOIN qt ON pq.q = qt.q),
prod AS (SELECT prod_id, SUM(psales) AS total FROM pq GROUP BY prod_id),
ranked AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM prod
),
top AS (SELECT prod_id FROM ranked WHERE rn <= (n + 4) / 5),
chg AS (
  SELECT t.prod_id,
    ABS(COALESCE(s2.share, 0) - COALESCE(s1.share, 0)) * 100 AS pp_change
  FROM top t
  LEFT JOIN ps s1 ON s1.prod_id = t.prod_id AND s1.q = 1772
  LEFT JOIN ps s2 ON s2.prod_id = t.prod_id AND s2.q = 1776
)
SELECT c.prod_id, p.prod_name, c.pp_change
FROM chg c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.prod_id = c.prod_id
WHERE c.pp_change = (SELECT MIN(pp_change) FROM chg);

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT CompanyName, Location,
         CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(Salary), '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/yr', '') AS REAL) AS sal
  FROM SalaryDataset
  WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL
),
clean AS (
  SELECT * FROM parsed WHERE sal IS NOT NULL AND sal > 0
),
comp AS (
  SELECT Location, CompanyName, AVG(sal) AS avg_sal
  FROM clean
  WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
  GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT Location, CompanyName, avg_sal,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Location ORDER BY avg_sal DESC) AS rn
  FROM comp
),
nat AS (
  SELECT AVG(sal) AS nat_avg FROM clean
)
SELECT r.Location AS Location,
       r.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
       ROUND(r.avg_sal, 2) AS "Average Salary in State",
       ROUND(n.nat_avg, 2) AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked r
CROSS JOIN nat n
WHERE r.rn <= 5
ORDER BY r.Location, r.avg_sal DESC
